# Embla Set

# Introduction

The Embla Set is an Ashlands-tier armor. This set is the tier above Carapace Armor and the Eitr-weave Set, and should be considered a "light armor," having a lower armor value than Flametal Armor and the Ask Set. The armor grants even higher Eitr regeneration than the Eitr-weave Set, which makes it the preferred armor when using magic weapons.

## Armor pieces

This set of armor has three pieces that are crafted and upgraded at the Galdr table. The Embla Set can currently only be upgraded to quality level 3.

## Trivia

• In Norse mythology, Ask and Embla (Old Norse: "Askr ok Embla") — man and woman respectively — were the first two humans, created by the gods (one of whom is Odin).
• The etymology of "embla" is uncertain, and two possibilities of the meaning of "embla" are generally proposed. The first meaning, "elm tree" is reached by deriving *Elm-la from *Almilōn and subsequently to "almr" ('elm'). The second suggestion is "vine", which is reached through *Ambilō, which may be related to the Greek term ἄμπελος (ámpelos), itself meaning "vine, liana".
